name: 26397-soloeagle-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct as the target, float16, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE v1 draft head. The target is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- same weights; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256; draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle, one decoder layer, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 400 requests with a 1200 s safety cap. streams=1 is the declared operating point and must not be walked upward by a cliff search.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42, 512 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens exactly -- no stdev, so every request is the same shape. guidellm sends `ignore_eos`, so each request generates its full 256 tokens.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on one accelerator, answering 512-token prompts with 256-token replies using speculative drafting.
launch:
# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, same weights; the Meta Llama 3
# Community License applies.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the target checkpoint's bfloat16: the EAGLE head below is a float16 checkpoint
# and this loads both in one dtype.
dtype: float16

# Forced: the draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048 and the engine hands the draft
# model the TARGET's context length, so the target must be capped to it or startup raises.
context-length: 2048
# Must not exceed context-length: a larger prefill-graph warmup overruns the per-request token table and bring-up dies with an illegal memory access.
piecewise-cuda-graph-max-tokens: 2048

# Greedy single-path EAGLE drafting. EAGLE, not EAGLE3: a different draft architecture.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.8
